name: Toasted Coconut Flakes
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Crack open the coconut, and separate out the coconut meat.
Grate the coconut meat into flakes.
Toss the coconut flakes with sugar and a pinch of salt.
Spread the coconut mixture on a baking sheet, and place on the lowest rack of the oven. Bake at 300˚F, stirring every few minutes until golden brown and crisp.
Remove the coconut flakes and cool completely.
